paths.title: Registered PST paths
paths.note: Sync only adds mail. Mail deleted or moved in Outlook is kept.

cap.queued: Starts after the current sync finishes.
cap.locked: Another program is using this file. The next scheduled run retries automatically.
cap.disabled: Mail stays in the database. The schedule and Sync all skip this path.

sched.title: Sync schedule
sched.off: Off (only runs when you press Sync now)
sched.note: The schedule only runs while Outlooker is open. A run missed while it was closed runs once on the next start. A file whose size and modified time did not change is skipped without reading.

activity.title: Current activity
activity.idle: No sync or import is running.
activity.retryNext: Retried on the next scheduled run.

log.title: Error log
log.none: No errors or warnings for this PST path.

empty.title: No PST path registered
empty.body: Add the path of an Outlook PST file. Outlooker imports it fully once, then only brings in new mail on the schedule.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.body: This PST file brought {{n}} messages. Messages that exist only in this PST file are deleted. Messages also found in other PST files are kept. The PST file itself is not changed.
